title: WiFi Connection Drops Intermittently
solution:
1. Update WiFi drivers from Device Manager
2. Change WiFi channel on router (1, 6, or 11 for 2.4GHz)
3. Disable power saving for WiFi adapter
4. Reset network settings: netsh winsock reset
5. Update router firmware

title: Unable to Connect to Corporate WiFi
solution:
1. Verify you're using correct credentials (domain\username)
2. Forget network and reconnect
3. Check if account is locked in Active Directory
4. Ensure device is domain-joined
5. Update security certificates

title: No Internet Connection Despite WiFi Connected
symptoms: wifi shows connected but pages won't load
solution:
1. Run Network Troubleshooter (Settings > Network > Troubleshoot)
2. Flush DNS cache: ipconfig /flushdns
3. Release and renew IP: ipconfig /release then ipconfig /renew
4. Check proxy settings are disabled
5. Try Google DNS (8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4)
6. Restart router and modem

title: VPN Connection Failed
solution:
1. Check internet connection first
2. Verify VPN credentials are correct
3. Try different VPN server/location
4. Disable firewall temporarily to test
5. Reinstall VPN client
6. Check if your IP is blocked (contact IT if on shared network)

title: Login Failed - Account Locked
solution:
1. Wait 30 minutes for automatic unlock
2. OR call IT helpdesk for immediate unlock
3. Reset password via self-service portal
4. Enable MFA if not already active
5. Check for suspicious login attempts in account activity

title: Password Reset Required
solution:
1. Go to password reset portal: https://passwordreset.company.com
2. Verify identity with security questions or phone
3. Create new password (min 12 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number, 1 symbol)
4. Update password on all devices
5. Update saved passwords in browsers
prerequisites: Access to recovery email or phone

title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Issues
solution:
1. Ensure phone time is synced (automatic time zone)
2. Check if authenticator app needs update
3. Use backup codes if available
4. Request MFA reset from IT helpdesk
5. Verify phone number for SMS codes is correct
prerequisites: Access to registered phone or backup codes

title: Slow Computer Performance
solution:
1. Check Task Manager for high CPU/memory usage (Ctrl+Shift+Esc)
2. Close unnecessary programs and browser tabs
3. Run Disk Cleanup (search 'Disk Cleanup' in Start)
4. Check for malware with Windows Defender full scan
5. Disable startup programs (Task Manager > Startup tab)
6. Restart computer if not done recently

title: Computer Freezing or Crashing
solution:
1. Note any error codes from blue screen
2. Check for Windows updates and install
3. Update all drivers (especially graphics)
4. Run System File Checker: sfc /scannow
5. Check hard drive health: wmic diskdrive get status
6. Check for overheating - clean vents and fans

title: External Monitor Not Detected
solution:
1. Check cable connections (unplug and replug)
2. Try different cable or port
3. Press Win+P and select 'Extend' or 'Duplicate'
4. Update graphics drivers
5. Try: Settings > Display > Detect
6. Restart computer with monitor connected

title: Keyboard or Mouse Not Working
solution:
1. Try different USB port
2. Check batteries if wireless
3. Try device on another computer
4. Update or reinstall drivers in Device Manager
5. Check for physical damage
6. For Bluetooth: Remove and re-pair device
prerequisites: Spare USB port or device for testing

title: Laptop Battery Draining Fast
solution:
1. Check battery health: powercfg /batteryreport
2. Reduce screen brightness
3. Enable Battery Saver mode
4. Check for power-hungry apps in Task Manager
5. Update BIOS and chipset drivers
6. Consider battery replacement if health <40%

title: Application Won't Install
solution:
1. Run installer as Administrator
2. Check available disk space (need 2x installer size)
3. Temporarily disable antivirus
4. Clear temp files: %temp% folder
5. Download fresh installer
6. Check Windows Event Viewer for specific error

title: Application Crashing on Startup
solution:
1. Run as Administrator
2. Check for application updates
3. Clear app cache/data
4. Reinstall the application
5. Check compatibility mode (right-click > Properties > Compatibility)
6. Update Windows and graphics drivers

title: Microsoft Office Not Activating
solution:
1. Sign out and sign back into Office
2. Check subscription status at account.microsoft.com
3. Run Office repair: Control Panel > Programs > Office > Change > Repair
4. Clear Office credentials in Credential Manager
5. Contact IT for license reassignment if needed

title: Outlook Not Syncing Emails
solution:
1. Check if Outlook is in Offline mode (Send/Receive tab)
2. Check internet connection
3. Repair Office installation
4. Create new Outlook profile
5. Clear Outlook cache
6. Check with webmail if server is working

title: Cannot Send or Receive Emails
solution:
1. Check internet connection
2. Verify email settings (server, port, SSL)
3. Check if mailbox is full
4. Verify attachment size limits
5. Check spam/junk folder for missing emails
6. Test with webmail to isolate issue

title: Printer Not Working
solution:
1. Check printer is powered on and connected
2. Clear print queue (Services > Print Spooler > Restart)
3. Set printer as default
4. Update printer drivers
5. Remove and re-add printer
6. Try printing a test page

title: Audio/Sound Not Working
solution:
1. Check volume isn't muted (click speaker icon)
2. Right-click speaker icon > Sound settings > Output device
3. Update audio drivers in Device Manager
4. Run Audio Troubleshooter (Settings > Sound > Troubleshoot)
5. Check audio cable connections
6. Test with different headphones/speakers

title: Windows Update Failing
solution:
1. Run Windows Update Troubleshooter
2. Clear update cache: Stop Windows Update service, delete C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution, restart service
3. Run: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth
4. Run: sfc /scannow
5. Try updating in Safe Mode
6. Manual download from Microsoft Update Catalog
